name: Skarsnik
canonNotes: Warlord of the Night Goblins of Karak Eight Peaks, famously cunning, with his giant squig Gobbla.
Wages a clever, endless war against Belegar's Dwarfs and the Skaven for the ruins.
voiceNotes: Sly, mocking and gleeful; Goblin cackles and nasty jokes.
Loves tricks, ambushes and outwitting 'stunties'; cowardly when cornered.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
